communication_contract.screen_evidence_parameter: Concise description of the attached current screen, per the screen-evidence convention in the system prompt.
communication_contract.evidence_refs_parameter: Array of existing obs_/fact_ ids explicitly selected to support the claimed results. Device completion needs grounded references; omission does not use the task ledger. Check every requested outcome, not merely whether one action succeeded.
communication_contract.terminal_observation_ref_parameter: The obs_ id of the latest raw observed screen that proves the terminal state, per the system prompt.

messages.max_device_task_wall_stop: The active device execution reached its configured time budget after {seconds} seconds without verified completion.
messages.manual_takeover_resumed: [MANUAL_TAKEOVER_RESUMED] The user completed manual takeover. Pre-pause actions were discarded, a fresh current screen is attached, and the original task remains unfinished.
messages.user_intervention_invalid_request: The task is paused because a human takeover request could not be completed. Please take over and explicitly resume when ready.
messages.user_intervention_not_paused: [USER_INTERVENTION_PROTOCOL_ERROR] The user-intervention tool completed without entering the required paused state; device execution is stopped.
messages.completion_protocol_unconfirmed: Completion could not be confirmed because the final response did not satisfy the completion protocol. Earlier actions and the candidate response remain in the task history; they have not been marked as verified completion.
messages.context_compaction_unavailable: Context summarization could not finish within its retry and time budget. Execution has stopped before completion was confirmed. Earlier actions, evidence and the previous context checkpoint remain preserved.
messages.context_checkpoint_failed: The local context checkpoint could not be persisted ({error}); the task stopped to preserve the durable event history.
messages.turn_canceled: [TURN_CANCELED] The active device tool was canceled with the surrounding turn.
messages.empty_final_response: Return either the next tool action or a non-empty final answer grounded in the current task evidence.
messages.terminal_protocol_error: The model response did not provide a valid public terminal result.
messages.channel_unavailable_hint: Device input or screenshot channel is unavailable.
messages.channel_unavailable_stop: Device channel is unavailable; user takeover is required.
messages.model_timeout: The model response timed out before the turn could finish.
messages.context_limit_exceeded: [CONTEXT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED] The protected task state, current evidence, tool schema, and current observation exceed the model context window. Stop this turn without dropping the latest closed evidence.
messages.virtual_space_empty_frame_guidance: The virtual display has no renderable content yet.
